005package org.wpilib.command3;
006
007import static org.wpilib.units.Units.Seconds;
008import static org.wpilib.util.ErrorMessages.requireNonNullParam;
009
010import java.util.ArrayDeque;
011import java.util.ArrayList;
012import java.util.Deque;
013import java.util.EnumMap;
014import java.util.List;
015import java.util.Map;
016import java.util.function.BooleanSupplier;
017import org.wpilib.event.EventLoop;
018import org.wpilib.math.filter.Debouncer;
019import org.wpilib.system.Timer;
020import org.wpilib.units.measure.Time;
021
022/**
023 * Triggers allow users to specify conditions for when commands should run. Triggers can be set up
024 * to read from joystick and controller buttons (eg {@link
025 * org.wpilib.command3.button.CommandGamepad#faceDown()}) or be customized to read sensor values or
026 * any other arbitrary true/false condition.
027 *
028 * <p>It is very easy to link a button to a command. For instance, you could link the trigger button
029 * of a joystick to a "score" command.
030 *
031 * <p>Triggers can easily be composed for advanced functionality using the {@link
032 * #and(BooleanSupplier)}, {@link #or(BooleanSupplier)}, {@link #negate()} operators.
033 *
034 * <table>
035 * <caption>Positive trigger command bindings</caption>
036 * <tr>
037 * <th>Method</th>
038 * <th>Schedules</th>
039 * <th>Cancels on false</th>
040 * </tr>
041 * <tr>
042 * <td>{@link #onTrue(Command)}</td>
043 * <td>On a rising edge</td>
044 * <td>No</td>
045 * </tr>
046 * <tr>
047 * <td>{@link #ifTrue(Command)}</td>
048 * <td>On every true poll</td>
049 * <td>No</td>
050 * </tr>
051 * <tr>
052 * <td>{@link #whileTrue(Command)}</td>
053 * <td>On a rising edge</td>
054 * <td>Yes</td>
055 * </tr>
056 * <tr>
057 * <td>{@link #retryWhileTrue(Command)}</td>
058 * <td>On every true poll</td>
059 * <td>Yes</td>
060 * </tr>
061 * </table>
062 *
063 * <p>Trigger bindings created inside a running command will only be active while that command is
064 * running. This is useful for defining trigger-based behavior only in a certain scope and avoids
065 * needing to create dozens of global triggers. Any commands scheduled by these triggers will be
066 * canceled when the enclosing command exits.
067 *
068 * <pre>{@code
069 * Command shootWhileAiming = Command.noRequirements(co -> {
070 *   turret.atTarget.onTrue(shooter.shootOnce());
071 *   co.await(turret.lockOnGoal());
072 * }).named("Shoot While Aiming");
073 * controller.rightBumper().whileTrue(shootWhileAiming);
074 * }</pre>
075 */
076public class Trigger implements BooleanSupplier {
077  private final BooleanSupplier m_condition;
078  private final EventLoop m_loop;
079  private final Scheduler m_scheduler;
080  private final BindingScope m_lifetimeScope;
081
082  /** The value of the signal before the most recent call to {@link #poll()}. May be null. */
083  private Signal m_previousSignal;
084
085  /** The value of the signal from the most recent call to {@link #poll()}. May be null. */
086  private Signal m_cachedSignal;
087
088  private final Map<BindingType, List<Binding>> m_bindings = new EnumMap<>(BindingType.class);
089  private final Runnable m_eventLoopCallback = this::poll;
090
091  /**
092   * Represents the state of a signal: high or low. Used instead of a boolean for nullity on the
093   * first run, when the previous signal value is undefined and unknown.
094   */
095  enum Signal {
096    /** The signal is high. */
097    HIGH,
098    /** The signal is low. */
099    LOW
100  }
101
102  /**
103   * Creates a new trigger based on the given condition. Polled by the scheduler's {@link
104   * Scheduler#getDefaultEventLoop() default event loop}.
105   *
106   * @param scheduler The scheduler that should execute triggered commands.
107   * @param condition the condition represented by this trigger
108   */
109  public Trigger(Scheduler scheduler, BooleanSupplier condition) {
110    this(
111        requireNonNullParam(scheduler, "scheduler", "Trigger"),
112        scheduler.getDefaultEventLoop(),
113        requireNonNullParam(condition, "condition", "Trigger"));
114  }
115
116  /**
117   * Creates a new trigger based on the given condition. Triggered commands are executed by the
118   * {@link Scheduler#getDefault() default scheduler}.
119   *
120   * <p>Polled by the default scheduler button loop.
121   *
122   * @param condition the condition represented by this trigger
123   */
124  public Trigger(BooleanSupplier condition) {
125    this(Scheduler.getDefault(), condition);
126  }
127
128  /**
129   * Creates a new trigger based on the given condition.
130   *
131   * @param scheduler The scheduler that should execute triggered commands.
132   * @param loop The event loop to poll the trigger.
133   * @param condition the condition represented by this trigger
134   */
135  @SuppressWarnings("this-escape")
136  public Trigger(Scheduler scheduler, EventLoop loop, BooleanSupplier condition) {
137    m_scheduler = requireNonNullParam(scheduler, "scheduler", "Trigger");
138    m_loop = requireNonNullParam(loop, "loop", "Trigger");
139    m_condition = requireNonNullParam(condition, "condition", "Trigger");
140
141    // Treat robot mode scopes as globals for the purposes of trigger object lifetimes.
142    // Any bindings made to the trigger will still use the appropriate scopes, but this prevents
143    // bugs where a trigger created in eg `autonomousInit()` and cached, then later rebound in
144    // `teleopInit()`, would get removed from the scheduler _after_ the new binding was added in
145    // `teleopInit()` due to init functions running _before_ `robotPeriodic()`.
146    // This does open the possibility for these triggers to never be cleaned up, but robot mode
147    // changes are so infrequent that it's not a big deal.
148    m_lifetimeScope =
149        switch (BindingScope.createNarrowestScope(m_scheduler)) {
150          case BindingScope.RobotModeScope _ -> BindingScope.Global.INSTANCE;
151          case BindingScope useMe -> useMe;
152        };
153
154    m_scheduler.addBoundTrigger(this);
155    m_loop.bindWeak(m_eventLoopCallback);
156  }
157
158  /**
159   * Starts the given command whenever the condition changes from `false` to `true`.
160   *
161   * @param command the command to start
162   * @return this trigger, so calls can be chained
163   */
164  public Trigger onTrue(Command command) {
165    requireNonNullParam(command, "command", "onTrue");
166    addBinding(BindingType.SCHEDULE_ON_RISING_EDGE, command);
167    return this;
168  }
169
170  /**
171   * Starts the given command on every event-loop poll where the condition is {@code true}.
172   *
173   * <p>This does not cancel the command when the condition becomes {@code false}; use {@link
174   * #whileTrue(Command)} for that behavior. Scheduling an already-running command follows ordinary
175   * scheduler behavior and does not restart it.
176   *
177   * @param command the command to start
178   * @return this trigger, so calls can be chained
179   */
180  public Trigger ifTrue(Command command) {
181    requireNonNullParam(command, "command", "ifTrue");
182    addBinding(BindingType.SCHEDULE_WHILE_HIGH, command);
183    return this;
184  }
185
186  /**
187   * Starts the given command whenever the condition changes from `true` to `false`.
188   *
189   * @param command the command to start
190   * @return this trigger, so calls can be chained
191   */
192  public Trigger onFalse(Command command) {
193    requireNonNullParam(command, "command", "onFalse");
194    addBinding(BindingType.SCHEDULE_ON_FALLING_EDGE, command);
195    return this;
196  }
197
198  /**
199   * Starts the given command when the condition changes to `true` and cancels it when the condition
200   * changes to `false`.
201   *
202   * <p>Unlike {@link #retryWhileTrue(Command)}, this does <strong>not</strong> restart the command
203   * if it ends while the condition is still `true`.
204   *
205   * @param command the command to start
206   * @return this trigger, so calls can be chained
207   */
208  public Trigger whileTrue(Command command) {
209    requireNonNullParam(command, "command", "whileTrue");
210    addBinding(BindingType.RUN_WHILE_HIGH, command);
211    return this;
212  }
213
214  /**
215   * Starts the given command when the condition changes to `false` and cancels it when the
216   * condition changes to `true`.
217   *
218   * <p>Unlike {@link #retryWhileFalse(Command)}, this does <strong>not</strong> restart the command
219   * if it ends while the condition is still `false`.
220   *
221   * @param command the command to start
222   * @return this trigger, so calls can be chained
223   */
224  public Trigger whileFalse(Command command) {
225    requireNonNullParam(command, "command", "whileFalse");
226    addBinding(BindingType.RUN_WHILE_LOW, command);
227    return this;
228  }
229
230  /**
231   * Starts the given command when the condition changes to `true` and cancels it when the condition
232   * changes to `false`.
233   *
234   * <p>Unlike {@link #whileTrue(Command)}, the command is restarted if it ends while the condition
235   * is still `true`. If the command stopped because it was interrupted, restarting it will
236   * immediately interrupt the would-be interrupting command (if they have the same priority).
237   *
238   * @param command the command to start
239   * @return this trigger, so calls can be chained
240   */
241  public Trigger retryWhileTrue(Command command) {
242    requireNonNullParam(command, "command", "retryWhileTrue");
243    addBinding(BindingType.CONTINUOUSLY_SCHEDULE_WHILE_HIGH, command);
244    return this;
245  }
246
247  /**
248   * Starts the given command when the condition changes to `false` and cancels it when the
249   * condition changes to `true`.
250   *
251   * <p>Unlike {@link #whileFalse(Command)}, the command is restarted if it ends while the condition
252   * is still `false`. If the command stopped because it was interrupted, restarting it will
253   * immediately interrupt the would-be interrupting command (if they have the same priority).
254   *
255   * @param command the command to start
256   * @return this trigger, so calls can be chained
257   */
258  public Trigger retryWhileFalse(Command command) {
259    requireNonNullParam(command, "command", "retryWhileFalse");
260    addBinding(BindingType.CONTINUOUSLY_SCHEDULE_WHILE_LOW, command);
261    return this;
262  }
263
264  /**
265   * Toggles a command when the condition changes from `false` to `true`.
266   *
267   * @param command the command to toggle
268   * @return this trigger, so calls can be chained
269   */
270  public Trigger toggleOnTrue(Command command) {
271    requireNonNullParam(command, "command", "toggleOnTrue");
272    addBinding(BindingType.TOGGLE_ON_RISING_EDGE, command);
273    return this;
274  }
275
276  /**
277   * Toggles a command when the condition changes from `true` to `false`.
278   *
279   * @param command the command to toggle
280   * @return this trigger, so calls can be chained
281   */
282  public Trigger toggleOnFalse(Command command) {
283    requireNonNullParam(command, "command", "toggleOnFalse");
284    addBinding(BindingType.TOGGLE_ON_FALLING_EDGE, command);
285    return this;
286  }
287
288  /**
289   * Gets the boolean state of the trigger. Because triggers are checked when their event loop is
290   * polled, which by default occurs when {@link Scheduler#run()} is called in user code, but may
291   * differ for custom event loops, the state is only valid immediately after the event loop is
292   * polled. If the underlying signal changes without a subsequent event loop poll, the return value
293   * from {@code getAsBoolean()} may not agree with the result of checking the signal directly.
294   *
295   * <p>This method will always return {@code false} before being polled by an event loop.
296   *
297   * @return The state of the trigger.
298   */
299  @Override
300  public boolean getAsBoolean() {
301    return m_cachedSignal == Signal.HIGH;
302  }
303
304  /**
305   * Composes two triggers with logical AND.
306   *
307   * @param trigger the condition to compose with
308   * @return A trigger which is active when both component triggers are active.
309   */
310  public Trigger and(BooleanSupplier trigger) {
311    return new Trigger(m_scheduler, m_loop, () -> getAsBoolean() && trigger.getAsBoolean());
312  }
313
314  /**
315   * Composes two triggers with logical OR.
316   *
317   * @param trigger the condition to compose with
318   * @return A trigger which is active when either component trigger is active.
319   */
320  public Trigger or(BooleanSupplier trigger) {
321    return new Trigger(m_scheduler, m_loop, () -> getAsBoolean() || trigger.getAsBoolean());
322  }
323
324  /**
325   * Creates a new trigger that is active when this trigger is inactive, i.e. that acts as the
326   * negation of this trigger.
327   *
328   * @return the negated trigger
329   */
330  public Trigger negate() {
331    return new Trigger(m_scheduler, m_loop, () -> !getAsBoolean());
332  }
333
334  /**
335   * Creates a new debounced trigger from this trigger - it will become active when this trigger has
336   * been active for longer than the specified period.
337   *
338   * @param duration The debounce period.
339   * @return The debounced trigger (rising edges debounced only)
340   */
341  public Trigger debounce(Time duration) {
342    return debounce(duration, Debouncer.DebounceType.RISING);
343  }
344
345  /**
346   * Creates a new debounced trigger from this trigger - it will become active when this trigger has
347   * been active for longer than the specified period.
348   *
349   * @param duration The debounce period.
350   * @param type The debounce type.
351   * @return The debounced trigger.
352   */
353  public Trigger debounce(Time duration, Debouncer.DebounceType type) {
354    var debouncer = new Debouncer(duration.in(Seconds), type);
355    return new Trigger(m_scheduler, m_loop, () -> debouncer.calculate(getAsBoolean()));
356  }
357
358  /**
359   * Creates a trigger that activates on a rising edge of this trigger's signal. The rising edge
360   * trigger is active in the same cycle that this trigger's condition is {@code true} while its
361   * condition in the previous cycle was {@code false}. The resulting trigger will only be active
362   * for that single cycle before going inactive again; therefore, {@link #onTrue(Command)} should
363   * be used instead of {@link #whileTrue(Command)}, as commands bound using the latter method will
364   * be immediately canceled after a single scheduler cycle.
365   *
366   * @return A rising edge trigger.
367   */
368  public Trigger risingEdge() {
369    return new Trigger(
370        m_scheduler, m_loop, () -> m_cachedSignal == Signal.HIGH && m_previousSignal == Signal.LOW);
371  }
372
373  /**
374   * Creates a trigger that activates on a falling edge of this trigger's signal. The falling edge
375   * trigger is active in the same cycle that this trigger's condition is {@code false} while its
376   * condition in the previous cycle was {@code true}. The resulting trigger will only be active for
377   * that single cycle before going inactive again; therefore, {@link #onTrue(Command)} should be
378   * used instead of {@link #whileTrue(Command)}, as commands bound using the latter method will be
379   * immediately canceled after a single scheduler cycle.
380   *
381   * @return A falling edge trigger.
382   */
383  public Trigger fallingEdge() {
384    return new Trigger(
385        m_scheduler, m_loop, () -> m_cachedSignal == Signal.LOW && m_previousSignal == Signal.HIGH);
386  }
387
388  /**
389   * Creates a trigger that activates when this trigger has at least {@code pressCount} rising edges
390   * within the specified duration.
391   *
392   * @param pressCount The number of rising edges to require. If this is non-positive, the trigger
393   *     will always be active.
394   * @param duration The duration within which the rising edges must occur. If this is non-positive,
395   *     the trigger will never activate.
396   * @return A trigger that activates on multiple presses
397   */
398  public Trigger multiPress(int pressCount, Time duration) {
399    requireNonNullParam(duration, "duration", "multiTap");
400
401    // Short circuits to avoid unnecessary state tracking and object allocations
402    if (duration.baseUnitMagnitude() <= 0) {
403      // A nonpositive window size can never be met
404      return new Trigger(m_scheduler, m_loop, () -> false);
405    } else if (pressCount <= 0) {
406      // A nonpositive press count is always met
407      return new Trigger(m_scheduler, m_loop, () -> true);
408    }
409
410    final double durationSeconds = duration.in(Seconds);
411
412    return new Trigger(
413        m_scheduler,
414        m_loop,
415        new BooleanSupplier() {
416          // Note: unlike EdgeCounterFilter, this implementation tracks timestamps directly
417          // and remains high even if the signal is low, just as long as the number of rising edges
418          // meets the criteria. EdgeCounterFilter is only high when the requisite number of edges
419          // have been seen _and_ the signal is high.
420          private final Deque<Double> m_timestamps = new ArrayDeque<>();
421          private boolean m_risingEdgeOccurred = false;
422
423          @Override
424          public boolean getAsBoolean() {
425            if (m_cachedSignal == Signal.HIGH && m_previousSignal != Signal.HIGH) {
426              if (!m_risingEdgeOccurred) {
427                m_timestamps.addLast(Timer.getTimestamp());
428                m_risingEdgeOccurred = true;
429              }
430            } else if (m_cachedSignal != Signal.HIGH) {
431              m_risingEdgeOccurred = false;
432            }
433
434            double currentTime = Timer.getTimestamp();
435            while (!m_timestamps.isEmpty()
436                && currentTime - m_timestamps.peekFirst() > durationSeconds + 1e-9) {
437              m_timestamps.removeFirst();
438            }
439
440            return m_timestamps.size() >= pressCount;
441          }
442        });
443  }
444
445  private void poll() {
446    // Clear bindings that no longer need to run
447    // This should always be checked, regardless of signal change, since bindings may be scoped
448    // and those scopes may become inactive.
449    clearStaleBindings();
450
451    m_previousSignal = m_cachedSignal;
452    m_cachedSignal = readSignal();
453
454    // Always attempt to schedule bindings based on the current signal
455    if (m_cachedSignal == Signal.HIGH) {
456      scheduleBindings(BindingType.SCHEDULE_WHILE_HIGH);
457      scheduleBindings(BindingType.CONTINUOUSLY_SCHEDULE_WHILE_HIGH);
458    } else if (m_cachedSignal == Signal.LOW) {
459      scheduleBindings(BindingType.CONTINUOUSLY_SCHEDULE_WHILE_LOW);
460    }
461
462    if (m_cachedSignal == m_previousSignal) {
463      // No change in the signal. Nothing to do
464      return;
465    }
466
467    if (m_cachedSignal == Signal.HIGH) {
468      // Signal is now high when it wasn't before - a rising edge
469      scheduleBindings(BindingType.SCHEDULE_ON_RISING_EDGE);
470      scheduleBindings(BindingType.RUN_WHILE_HIGH);
471      cancelBindings(BindingType.RUN_WHILE_LOW);
472      cancelBindings(BindingType.CONTINUOUSLY_SCHEDULE_WHILE_LOW);
473      toggleBindings(BindingType.TOGGLE_ON_RISING_EDGE);
474    }
475
476    if (m_cachedSignal == Signal.LOW) {
477      // Signal is now low when it wasn't before - a falling edge
478      scheduleBindings(BindingType.SCHEDULE_ON_FALLING_EDGE);
479      scheduleBindings(BindingType.RUN_WHILE_LOW);
480      cancelBindings(BindingType.RUN_WHILE_HIGH);
481      cancelBindings(BindingType.CONTINUOUSLY_SCHEDULE_WHILE_HIGH);
482      toggleBindings(BindingType.TOGGLE_ON_FALLING_EDGE);
483    }
484  }
485
486  private Signal readSignal() {
487    if (m_condition.getAsBoolean()) {
488      return Signal.HIGH;
489    } else {
490      return Signal.LOW;
491    }
492  }
493
494  /** Removes bindings in inactive scopes. Running commands tied to those bindings are canceled. */
495  private void clearStaleBindings() {
496    m_bindings.forEach(
497        (_bindingType, bindings) -> {
498          for (var iterator = bindings.iterator(); iterator.hasNext(); ) {
499            var binding = iterator.next();
500            if (binding.scope().active()) {
501              // This binding's scope is still active, leave it running
502              continue;
503            }
504
505            // The scope is no longer active. Remove the binding and immediately cancel its command.
506            iterator.remove();
507            m_scheduler.cancel(binding.command());
508          }
509        });
510  }
511
512  /**
513   * Schedules all commands bound to the given binding type.
514   *
515   * @param bindingType the binding type to schedule
516   */
517  private void scheduleBindings(BindingType bindingType) {
518    m_bindings.getOrDefault(bindingType, List.of()).forEach(m_scheduler::schedule);
519  }
520
521  /**
522   * Cancels all commands bound to the given binding type.
523   *
524   * @param bindingType the binding type to cancel
525   */
526  private void cancelBindings(BindingType bindingType) {
527    m_bindings
528        .getOrDefault(bindingType, List.of())
529        .forEach(binding -> m_scheduler.cancel(binding.command()));
530  }
531
532  /**
533   * Toggles all commands bound to the given binding type. If a command is currently scheduled or
534   * running, it will be canceled; otherwise, it will be scheduled.
535   *
536   * @param bindingType the binding type to cancel
537   */
538  private void toggleBindings(BindingType bindingType) {
539    m_bindings
540        .getOrDefault(bindingType, List.of())
541        .forEach(
542            binding -> {
543              var command = binding.command();
544              if (m_scheduler.isScheduledOrRunning(command)) {
545                m_scheduler.cancel(command);
546              } else {
547                m_scheduler.schedule(binding);
548              }
549            });
550  }
551
552  /**
553   * Package-private for testing. Reads the signal of the trigger as it was <i>after</i> the most
554   * recent call to {@link #poll()}. May be null.
555   *
556   * @return The most recent signal.
557   */
558  Signal getCachedSignal() {
559    return m_cachedSignal;
560  }
561
562  /**
563   * Package-private for testing. Reads the signal of the trigger as it was <i>before</i> the most
564   * recent call to {@link #poll()}. May be null.
565   *
566   * @return The previous signal.
567   */
568  Signal getPreviousSignal() {
569    return m_previousSignal;
570  }
571
572  // package-private for Scheduler
573  boolean isScopeActive() {
574    return m_lifetimeScope.active();
575  }
576
577  // package-private for testing
578  void addBinding(BindingScope scope, BindingType bindingType, Command command) {
579    // Note: we use a throwable here instead of Thread.currentThread().getStackTrace() for easier
580    //       stack frame filtering and modification.
581    m_bindings
582        .computeIfAbsent(bindingType, _k -> new ArrayList<>())
583        .add(new Binding(scope, bindingType, command, new Throwable().getStackTrace()));
584  }
585
586  private void addBinding(BindingType bindingType, Command command) {
587    var scope = BindingScope.createNarrowestScope(m_scheduler);
588    addBinding(scope, bindingType, command);
589  }
590}
